speaker: Benny
text: So close. I can't watch anymore.

speaker: Leonard
text: Oh my god, that's Ripley's robot? Sheldon, we have to call it off.

speaker: Sheldon
text: As you can see, the Ripley is reducing the Chevy Cavalier to rubble. We don't have that option. We've accepted the challenge. We can't run away from a fight.

speaker: Leonard
text: Oh, please. We spent our whole lives running away from fights. Personally, I can squeeze through a hole in a fence half my size.

speaker: Sheldon
text: But impressive as that may be, Monty is not us. Monty has no fear.

speaker: Benny
text: But, Shandon, do we all not just watch the same video? Could these robots just add angry sex to the mid-sized automobile? You are overlooking the fact that we now know what we're up against, and we can modify Monty so that he's prepared.

speaker: Leonard
text: You want to prepare him? Install a bladder and a pair of shorts so he can wet himself?

speaker: Benny
text: Excuse me, but are we going to make any modifications without Wolowitz? Have you ever been here?

speaker: Sheldon
text: Have faith, gentlemen. We don't need Wolowitz. Engineering is merely the slow, younger brother of physics. Watch and learn.
